{{Top|leg}}
A '''transponder node dart''' was a projectile fired from [[Culcanis MicroInstruments]]' [[Tagger]]. It was five [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeters]] in diameter and was propelled from the Tagger by pressurized [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. The [[Dart/Legends|dart]] attached to a target and transmitted a high-frequency signal which could be picked up by the Tagger up to 1.2 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away.
